notes: This contract records a portable IEEE 1516.1 TCK scenario for one timestamped Update Attribute Values invocation containing one timestamp-order attribute and one receive-order attribute. The receiver must observe distinct attribute-only callback messages for the two passels, with the corresponding receive-order and timestamp-order metadata. The provider, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation are adapter supplied. This is an API-level behavior check, not a provider-conformance claim.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues and separate receive-order/timestamp-order FederateAmbassador reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador attribute-order and update declarations; FederateAmbassador reflection declarations

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador.updateAttributeValues(LogicalTime) with mixed default attribute orders; FederateAmbassador.reflectAttributeValues with distinct attribute-only passels
